# Import preview checkpoint

Status: investigating the existing import pipeline and tests before edits.
Root cause: both import branches allocate persistent keys and invoke write/cover/IA operations directly; no shared save flag exists. `process_cover_url` embeds host checking, and the requested public converter names are absent.
Pattern: `load_data` already collects new author/work/edition dictionaries in `edits`; matched imports collect modified records similarly. Preview can return those same records while guarding side effects.
Hypothesis: passing `save=False` through key allocation, cover, and write boundaries will preserve construction while eliminating writes. The added regression test fails at collection as expected because `check_cover_url_host` is absent (`pytest -q openlibrary/catalog/add_book/tests/test_preview.py`, exit 1).
Implementation: added UUID preview keys, shared author edit collection, explicit cover host validation and preview acceptance reporting, write/IA/cover guards, endpoint flag propagation, and converter interfaces. The matched-work path now creates and reports author candidates. Author lookup continues to alternate-name queries after a date mismatch.
Checks: initial full relevant run failed 1 existing cover test because its fixture used a now-disallowed host; changed the fixture to an allowed Amazon host. A later run failed 1 matching test because the converter stopped normalizing the source record in place; restored the existing matching behavior. Another added test exposed an alternate-name fallback gap; fixed the query loop. An added malformed-cover test failed with `ValueError: Invalid IPv6 URL`; the host validator now returns False.
Final checks: `pytest -q openlibrary/catalog/add_book/tests openlibrary/plugins/importapi/tests/test_code.py` (171 passed, exit 0); `ruff check` on edited Python files (exit 0); `git diff --check` (exit 0). Warnings are existing deprecations from pytest-asyncio, Genshi, dateutil, and Pydantic.
Constraint: local repository only; no downloads or external research.
Tooling: `rg` is unavailable (`/bin/bash: rg: command not found`); using `find` and `grep`.

+from openlibrary.catalog.add_book import check_cover_url_host, load

+    author_import_record_to_author,
+    import_record_to_edition,

+
+
+def test_preview_new_book_has_edits_without_writes(mock_site, monkeypatch):
+    def forbidden(*args, **kwargs):
+        raise AssertionError('preview attempted a write')
+
+    monkeypatch.setattr(mock_site, 'save_many', forbidden)
+    monkeypatch.setattr(mock_site, 'new_key', forbidden)
+    result = load(
+        {'title': 'Preview title', 'source_records': ['marc:preview'],
+         'authors': [{'name': 'Doe, Jane'}]},
+        save=False,
+    )
+    assert result['preview'] is True
+    assert [edit['type']['key'] for edit in result['edits']] == [
+        '/type/author', '/type/work', '/type/edition'
+    ]
+    assert result['edition']['key'].startswith('/books/__new__')
+    assert result['work']['key'].startswith('/works/__new__')
+    assert result['authors'][0]['key'].startswith('/authors/__new__')
+
+
+def test_cover_host_allowlist_is_case_insensitive():
+    assert check_cover_url_host('https://M.MEDIA-AMAZON.COM/image.jpg', ['m.media-amazon.com'])
+    assert not check_cover_url_host('https://other.example/image.jpg', ['m.media-amazon.com'])
+    assert not check_cover_url_host(None, ['m.media-amazon.com'])
+    assert not check_cover_url_host('https://[invalid/image.jpg', ['m.media-amazon.com'])
+
+

+    })
+    mock_site.save({
+        'key': '/works/OL1W', 'title': 'Preview match',
+        'type': {'key': '/type/work'},
+    })
+
+    def forbidden(*args, **kwargs):
+        raise AssertionError('preview attempted a write')
+

+        'subjects': ['Preview subject'], 'languages': ['eng'],

+from openlibrary.catalog.add_book import check_cover_url_host, load
+from openlibrary.catalog.add_book.load_book import (
+    author_import_record_to_author,
+    import_record_to_edition,
+)
+
+
+def test_preview_new_book_has_edits_without_writes(mock_site, monkeypatch):
+    def forbidden(*args, **kwargs):
+        raise AssertionError('preview attempted a write')
+
+    monkeypatch.setattr(mock_site, 'save_many', forbidden)
+    monkeypatch.setattr(mock_site, 'new_key', forbidden)
+    result = load(
+        {'title': 'Preview title', 'source_records': ['marc:preview'],
+         'authors': [{'name': 'Doe, Jane'}]},
+        save=False,
+    )
+    assert result['preview'] is True
+    assert [edit['type']['key'] for edit in result['edits']] == [
+        '/type/author', '/type/work', '/type/edition'
+    ]
+    assert result['edition']['key'].startswith('/books/__new__')
+    assert result['work']['key'].startswith('/works/__new__')
+    assert result['authors'][0]['key'].startswith('/authors/__new__')
+
+
+def test_cover_host_allowlist_is_case_insensitive():
+    assert check_cover_url_host('https://M.MEDIA-AMAZON.COM/image.jpg', ['m.media-amazon.com'])
+    assert not check_cover_url_host('https://other.example/image.jpg', ['m.media-amazon.com'])
+    assert not check_cover_url_host(None, ['m.media-amazon.com'])
+    assert not check_cover_url_host('https://[invalid/image.jpg', ['m.media-amazon.com'])
+
+
+def test_preview_matched_edition_reports_modifications_without_writes(mock_site, add_languages, monkeypatch):
+    mock_site.save({
+        'key': '/books/OL1M', 'title': 'Preview match',
+        'type': {'key': '/type/edition'}, 'source_records': ['ia:preview-match'],
+        'works': [{'key': '/works/OL1W'}],
+    })
+    mock_site.save({
+        'key': '/works/OL1W', 'title': 'Preview match',
+        'type': {'key': '/type/work'},
+    })
+
+    def forbidden(*args, **kwargs):
+        raise AssertionError('preview attempted a write')
+
+    monkeypatch.setattr(mock_site, 'save_many', forbidden)
+    result = load({
+        'title': 'Preview match', 'source_records': ['ia:preview-match'],
+        'subjects': ['Preview subject'], 'languages': ['eng'],
+    }, save=False)
+    assert result['preview'] is True
+    assert result['edition']['status'] == 'modified'
+    assert result['work']['status'] == 'modified'
+    assert {edit['key'] for edit in result['edits']} == {'/books/OL1M', '/works/OL1W'}
+
+
+def test_import_converters_normalize_author_and_edition(add_languages, mock_site):
+    author = author_import_record_to_author({'name': 'Dr. Doe, Jane'})
+    assert author['name'] == 'Jane Doe'
+    edition = import_record_to_edition({
+        'title': 'Preview', 'authors': [{'name': 'Mr. Doe, John'}],
+        'description': 'Description', 'languages': ['ENG'],
+        'translated_from': ['fre'],
+    })
+    assert edition['authors'][0]['name'] == 'John Doe'
+    assert edition['description'] == {'type': '/type/text', 'value': 'Description'}
+    assert edition['languages'] == [{'key': '/languages/eng'}]
+    assert edition['translated_from'] == [{'key': '/languages/fre'}]
+
+
+def test_preview_rejects_cover_without_upload(mock_site, monkeypatch):
+    from openlibrary.catalog import add_book
+
+    def forbidden(*args, **kwargs):
+        raise AssertionError('cover upload attempted')
+
+    monkeypatch.setattr(add_book, 'add_cover', forbidden)
+    for cover in ('https://other.example/cover.jpg', 'https://M.MEDIA-AMAZON.COM/cover.jpg'):
+        result = load({
+            'title': 'Preview cover', 'source_records': ['marc:preview-cover'],
+            'cover': cover,
+        }, save=False)
+        assert result['cover_accepted'] == cover.startswith('https://M.MEDIA')
+        assert 'covers' not in result['edits'][-1]
+
+
+def test_preview_matched_work_includes_new_author(mock_site, monkeypatch):
+    mock_site.save({
+        'key': '/books/OL2M', 'title': 'Missing author',
+        'type': {'key': '/type/edition'}, 'source_records': ['ia:missing-author'],
+        'works': [{'key': '/works/OL2W'}],
+    })
+    mock_site.save({
+        'key': '/works/OL2W', 'title': 'Missing author',
+        'type': {'key': '/type/work'},
+    })
+    def forbidden(*args, **kwargs):
+        raise AssertionError('preview attempted a write')
+    monkeypatch.setattr(mock_site, 'save_many', forbidden)
+    result = load({
+        'title': 'Missing author', 'source_records': ['ia:missing-author'],
+        'authors': [{'name': 'Novel Author'}],
+    }, save=False)
+    assert result['authors'][0]['status'] == 'created'
+    assert result['authors'][0]['key'].startswith('/authors/__new__')
+    assert result['work']['status'] == 'modified'
+    assert {edit['type']['key'] for edit in result['edits']} >= {
+        '/type/author', '/type/work'
+    }
+
+
+def test_author_falls_back_to_alternate_name_when_exact_name_dates_differ(mock_site):
+    mock_site.save({
+        'key': '/authors/OL10A', 'name': 'Jane Doe',
+        'type': {'key': '/type/author'}, 'birth_date': '1900',
+    })
+    mock_site.save({
+        'key': '/authors/OL11A', 'name': 'Jane A. Doe',
+        'alternate_names': ['Jane Doe'], 'birth_date': '1901-02-03',
+        'type': {'key': '/type/author'},
+    })
+    found = author_import_record_to_author({'name': 'JANE DOE', 'birth_date': '1901'})
+    assert found['key'] == '/authors/OL11A'
+
+
+def test_preview_reports_invalid_language(mock_site):
+    result = load({
+        'title': 'Unknown language', 'source_records': ['marc:bad-language'],
+        'languages': ['xyz'],
+    }, save=False)
+    assert result['success'] is False
+    assert result['preview'] is True
+    assert result['edits'] == []
+    assert 'invalid language' in result['error']
